_comment: Intent selects the route; every route has a small and a large budget on different models, and a refusal for protected content on the small budget escalates to the large one (R-12, R-17). budget.input is computed from each model's context limit less what the route reserves (R-16). Both routes render cwa-message-blocks/v1 so cache reuse can be measured at block boundaries. The request's task is the client's account; prior turns are the session's.
